learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of basic subjects and technologies, which enables learning new methods and technologies, as well as providing great versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity.
Ease in handling specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Ability to autonomously learn new knowledge and techniques suitable for the conception, development, or exploitation of telecommunication systems and services.
Knowledge of telecommunications regulations and legislation at national, European, and international levels.
To provide and/or evaluate alternative or novel solutions to problems, demonstrating flexibility and professionalism when considering different evaluation criteria.
To solve problems within their area of study.
To analyze, synthesize, and evaluate.
To act autonomously.

To communicate knowledge, procedures, ideas, results, etc., orally and in writing, with special emphasis on the preparation of technical documentation, as well as to logically argue and justify the decisions made.
Identify and characterize the different types of disturbances that can affect the transmission process.
Characterize the different transmission media from the point of view of transmission parameters.
Relate transmission media/systems with the disturbances that limit the design in each of them.

Use legislation, regulations, standards, basic recommendations applicable in the design and planning of telecommunication systems, as well as recognize the main standardization bodies in telecommunications.
Handle specification sheets and commercial catalogs of elements to be used in the different telecommunication systems.
Design and evaluate a point-to-point fiber optic system.
Calculate the design parameters of an ADSL/VDSL connection.
Plan the distribution network of an HFC system by selecting the most suitable elements to satisfy the design conditions.
Understand and manage the fundamentals of cellular mobile systems.
Apply the basic knowledge acquired to the study, analysis, and design of new communication systems.

Evaluate possible technological solutions to provide a certain service, based on initial conditions and the search for applicable regulations, recommendations, etc., and select the most appropriate according to technical, economic, and/or other criteria.
Present and document appropriately the resolution of a problem, work, or project related to telecommunication systems.

syllabus_topics: Magnitudes and units used in telecommunication systems.
Crosstalk and interference (studied in corresponding units).
Laboratory project 1: Analysis of distortion in a telecommunication system.
Model of metallic transmission lines: primary parameters and secondary parameters.
Optical fiber: index profile, ray theory, modal theory, optical attenuation, modal dispersion, light sources, and photodetectors.
Laboratory project 2: Characterization of a guided transmission medium.
TEMA 4. Telecommunication systems based on guided transmission media
Digital Hierarchies: Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy (PDH), Synchronous Digital Hierarchy (SDH).
HFC Systems: Network architecture. Optical subnetwork. Synchronous Optical Network (SONET). Coaxial subnetwork. Design examples.
Laboratory project 3: Evaluation of a coaxial distribution network.
Propagation in the presence of obstacles.
Laboratory project 4: Characterization of an unguided transmission medium.
Effect of interference on cellular planning.
Laboratory project 5: Evaluation of a 5G mobile network.
Structure of a satellite communication system.
assessment_rules: The final grade for ordinary evaluation is the weighted average of (T1) x 0.4 + (T2) x 0.4 + (P1) x 0.2, and must be 5 points or higher to pass. A student will be considered 'No Presentado' if participation in evaluation activities is less than 50% of the total; otherwise, unsubmitted activities will be graded with 0 points. In extraordinary evaluation, assessment consists of a single written exam, graded as (0.8 x Theoretical content) + (0.2 x Laboratory practice content).
